title: Kulle asusu, ajiyewa, da kuma kula da imel da aka yi wa kutse

say: Kulle asusu, ajiyewa, da kuma kula da imel da aka yi wa kutse.
Wannan shi ne bidiyon don module 2 na Tushen Tsaro na Cyber.
Kayan aiki masu arha guda uku suna yin mafi yawan aikin kariya: mai sarrafa kalmar sirri, tabbatar da abubuwa da yawa, wanda muke kira MFA, da kuma kafa na'urori masu kyau.

Ƙananan haruffa 8 bazuwar suna faɗi cikin kusan daƙiƙa 21.

say: Kowace karin kalma tana ninka aikin maharin da 7,776, fiye da ƙara alama. Chiamaka ya zaɓi kalmomi shida bazuwar.

Wannan kadai kuke haddace. Mai sarrafa kalmar sirri yana ƙirƙirar kalmar sirri ta musamman ga kowane asusu, don haka ɗigo ɗaya ba zai iya buɗe sauran ba. Kalmomin sirri da aka sake amfani da su sune babban dalilin ƙwace asusun.

say: Kalmar sirri kadai ita ce mafi rauni. Lambobin SMS sun fi komai kyau, amma ana iya sace su ta hanyar zamba ta hanyar musayar SIM ko yaudarar mutane a wayar.

panel.heading: Ba duk MFA daidai yake ba

say: Aikace-aikacen tabbatarwa suna yin lamba shida a wayar kanta, suna canzawa kowane sakan 30. Maɓallan wucewa da maɓallan tsaro sun ci gaba: suna aiki ne kawai akan gidan yanar gizo na ainihi, don haka shafin shiga na karya ba ya samun komai.
Yi amfani da hanya mafi ƙarfi kowane sabis yana bayarwa, aƙalla don imel, banki da mai gudanarwa na kafofin watsa labarun. Ajiye lambobin dawowa akan takarda, a kulle.

panel.heading: Ba duk MFA daidai yake ba

say: Dokar 3-2-1 ta ce ajiye kwafi 3 na mahimman bayanai. Misali, Hauwa tana gudanar da IT don tuntubar mutum 6 a Kano. Tana adana fayilolin aiki, kwafin gajimare tare da tarihin sigar, da abin tuƙi na waje.

panel.heading: Dokar madadin 3-2-1

cards.d: Hauwa tana adana fayiloli masu aiki, kwafin girgije tare da tarihin sigar, da abin tuƙi na waje.
Ma'ajiyar gajimare tare da rumbun kwamfutarka na waje 1 TB. Ta yi girman tsarin girgije don watanni 12 na girma.
Wata-wata tana kwafewa kan tuƙi, tana cire kayan kuma ta ajiye shi a waje. Kowace kwata ta gwada maidowa.

say: Akan nau'ikan ajiya guda 2. Babban fayil ɗin yana da gigabytes 40 kuma yana girma kusan 2 a wata, don haka a cikin watanni 12 zai zama 64. Ta zaɓi tsarin girgije na akalla 100.

say: Tare da kwafi 1 a waje. Ransomware na iya ɓoye duk wani drive ɗin da aka haɗa a ciki, don haka sau ɗaya a wata ta kwafi babban fayil ɗin, ta cire na'urar ta tafi da shi.
Kowace kwata ta dawo da ƴan fayiloli ta buɗe su, ta rubuta kwanan wata da sakamakon. Ƙungiyoyi da yawa sun gano latti cewa ajiyar su ya tsaya watanni da suka gabata.

say: Don tunawa. Dogon kalmar wucewa ɗaya, da keɓaɓɓen kalmar sirri da aka samar don komai. Lambobin app da maɓallan wucewa suna bugun SMS. Ajiye maajiyar 3-2-1 da dawo da gwaji.
A cikin abin da ya faru, yi hoton shaidar, sannan a ƙunshi. Kuma agogon NDPC na awa 72 yana farawa ne lokacin da kuka sani.
